subject: Mathematics
title: Application of Integrals
summary: Definite integral curve ke neeche area deta hai: y = f(x), x-axis aur x = a, b ke beech area ∫ₐᵇ |f(x)| dx hai.

Do curves ke beech area unke intersection points ke beech ∫ (upper − lower) dx hai; kabhi-kabhi y ke respect mein integrate karna (right − left) aasaan hota hai. Circle, parabola aur ellipse ke standard areas yaad rakho.
Pehle sketch banao: intersection points nikalo, dekho kaunsi curve upar hai, aur jahan curves cross karein ya function sign badle wahan interval tod do.

formulas.name: Area under a curve
formulas.when: Curve aur x-axis ke beech area.
formulas.mistake: Agar f sign badalta hai to uske zeros par todo — warna areas cancel ho jaayenge, galat answer aayega.

formulas.name: Area with respect to y
formulas.when: x = g(y) se di gayi curves.

formulas.name: Area between curves
formulas.formula: A = ∫ₐᵇ [f(x) − g(x)] dx  with f ≥ g on [a, b]

formulas.name: Circle
formulas.formula: area of x² + y² = a² = πa²

formulas.name: Parabola and its latus rectum
formulas.formula: area bounded by y² = 4ax and x = a = 8a²/3

formulas.name: Parabola and line
formulas.formula: area between y = x² and y = x = 1/6;  between y² = 4ax and y = mx = 8a²/(3m³)

formulas.name: Symmetry
formulas.formula: use symmetry about the axes to compute one part and multiply
formulas.when: Circles, ellipses, parabolas mein kaam bachaana.

formulas.name: One arch of sine
formulas.when: y = sin x ke ek arch ka area.

examples.title: Parabola ke neeche
examples.problem: y = x² ke neeche x = 0 se 3 tak area?

examples.title: y = x aur y = x² ke beech
examples.problem: y = x aur y = x² se ghira area?
examples.solution: Ye x = 0, 1 par milte hain; ∫₀¹ (x − x²) dx = 1/2 − 1/3 = 1/6 ≈ 0.167.

examples.title: Parabola aur x-axis
examples.problem: y = 4x − x² aur x-axis ke beech area?

examples.title: Sine arch
examples.problem: 0 se π tak y = sin x ke neeche area?

examples.title: Latus rectum area
examples.problem: y² = 12x aur uske latus rectum se ghira area?

topics.title: Sketching tips
topics.explain: Intercepts, intersection points aur symmetry mark karo. Poochha gaya region shade karo; vertical strips (dx) ya horizontal strips (dy) chuno — jisme kam tukde lagein wo lo.

topics.title: Curves crossing the axis
topics.explain: [0, 2π] par y = sin x ka signed integral 0 hai par area 4. Hamesha |f(x)| use karo ya zeros par todo.

topics.title: Modulus and greatest integer curves
topics.explain: |x| ya [x] wale areas break points par tod kar nikaalte hain, aksar triangles aur rectangles bante hain jo geometry se nikal jaate hain.

topics.title: Inequality regions
topics.explain: {(x, y): x² ≤ y ≤ |x|} jaise regions ke liye boundary curves aur unke intersections pehchaano, phir upper minus lower integrate karo.

topics.title: Area via definite integral properties
topics.explain: Definite integrals ki King's property aur symmetry area calculations aasaan kar sakti hain.

topics.title: Area between a curve and the y-axis
topics.explain: y = c se y = d tak x = g(y) ke liye g(y) dy integrate karo. Example: y = 0 se 2 tak x = y² aur y-axis ke beech area 8/3 hai.
